items.title: Tate two-degree cohomological isomorphism for a class formation via a splitting module
items.difficulty_reason: After standard finite-group cohomology, cyclic periodicity, induced-module acyclicity, exact sequences and restriction/corestriction, the supplied proof still constructs a splitting module from a chosen H2 generator, proves uniform H1/H2 vanishing for every subgroup by restriction and finite-order control, applies all-degree Tate vanishing, and splices a four-term sequence to obtain the isomorphism. This core is not assumed as background; it exceeds a routine qualifying exercise. Independent bounded material review supports H2.
